record: Rule-6 mutants for pre-started waiting sessions in packages/polaris-dossier (owner direction POLARIS-DOSSIER-WAITING-SESSIONS-2026-10-08; candidate polaris-dossier-local-agent-mode v1.2, REQ-polaris-generation-035 as amended there), re-run in full after review-408 round 2 (docs/reviews/R-PR408-WAITING-SESSIONS-2-RAW.md). The population is every refusal, guard and disclosure predicate of the wait-mode code, re-derived from the files at `commit`: each `if`, conjunct and ternary in waiting-sessions.ts, the wait-mode paths of session-handover.ts (sessionCommands, waitingAllowedTools, the two waiting prompts, START_DISCLOSURES, startSessions, handOver, deliverReview and the launch-form refusal for a waiting session), the continuity items of render.ts, and in cli.ts the await exit codes, the stdin wiring and the two wait-mode flags given twice (`--stdin`, `--fresh`). The positional-count usage checks that every dossier command shares (exactly one run or session directory) are outside the population: they are the CLI's grammar for all commands, not a wait-mode predicate. Each predicate in the population has one mutant below, or one entry in `notMutated` with its reason. M1-M40 and S1-S10 are the first record's mutants; F1-F8 and N2 cover the round-1 repairs; F4a-F4af the predicates round-1 finding 4 named and the rest of the population; R2-* the round-2 repairs, and R2-NM7 the rethrow mutant round-2 finding 6 asked for. `builderMutants` covers the v1.2 builder, the v1.1 builder's peel and delegation, and the recorder's v1.2 entry. Not authority.

measuredOn.commitNote: Each mutant names the commit it ran at. All 125 ran at bf10c10e, where one survived: R2-4d-first-of-several-digests-taken, because the two-digest test put the non-matching digest first. b8896a97 puts the matching digest first in that test case and changes no other subject (compare the digests); R2-4d alone was re-run there and is the entry listed.

method: Each mutant replaces `old` with `new` (exactly one occurrence, else not applied) in one file of the worktree at its `commit`, runs `command` from the worktree root, then restores the file byte for byte. Killed when the replacement applied and the command exits nonzero, or `killed (timeout)` when the command was still running after 300 s (its process group is then killed). `failedTests` is read from Vitest's summary line. The tree under packages/ was clean after the run (`treeCleanAfter`).

notMutated.why: Unreachable through any input: decideExecutionRule returns the sec-3 arm for every role but 'authoring' (packages/polaris-dossier/src/execution-rule.ts, `if (inputs.role !== 'authoring') return sec3(...)`), and the inventory brief is built with the inventory role. A mutant would survive by construction.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts awaitSession: the clause `directoryArg.split('/').some((part) => part === '.' || part === '..')`
notMutated.why: Subsumed by the clause before it: path.normalize removes every '.' and '..' segment of an absolute path, so a path holding one never equals its normalisation and is already refused. M21 removes both clauses together and is killed; this clause alone cannot change an outcome.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts awaitSession: the clause `expected === undefined` in the brief re-hash
notMutated.why: Subsumed by the clause after it: a sha256 hex digest is never undefined, so `sha256(bytes) !== expected` refuses the same inputs. M16 removes that clause and is killed.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts sessionDirectoryRefusal: the two `lstatSync` catches (a sessions root, or a session directory, that does not exist)
notMutated.why: No write can follow either: with a catch removed, the exception leaves sessionDirectoryRefusal before await or the delivery writes anything, and a missing directory is refused by the next step anyway (`realOrNull` in await, the `mkdirSync` of the round in a delivery), so only the stage word or the error changes, never whether anything is written.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts sessionDirectoryRefusal: the two `realpathSync` catches (the sessions root and its parent; the session directory and the root)
notMutated.why: Reachable only when lstat has just succeeded and realpath then fails (an entry or an ancestor removed or made unreadable between the two calls); no test can place an input there without fault injection into node:fs.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts signoffRecordHolds, appliedSubjectHolds and waitModeSignedIn: each read's `catch { return false; }`, and the clause `review === undefined`
notMutated.why: Fail closed either way: without a catch (or with `review === undefined` dropped, `.split` of undefined throws) the exception leaves the gate, which every wait-mode step evaluates first (`if (!signed()) return refuse('unsigned', ...)`, session-handover.ts and waiting-sessions.ts), so the step neither opens nor writes. The gate tests reach each arm: a missing aggregate, a missing record, a record with no review and no installed spec.
Equivalent without it: readRecord of the session-0 prompt record finds no file, so the function returns null either way.
Reachable only by a race: sessionDirectoryRefusal has just resolved the same path's real path, so realpath fails here only if the directory vanished in between.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts awaitSession: `if (!result.ok) return refuse('check', ...)` after checkInventory and after reviewCheck
notMutated.why: Forwarding only: the refusal is the check's own, tested in check and review suites; the waiting code adds no predicate there, and since F5 a submission reaches the check only as bounded JSON.

notMutated.predicate: session-handover.ts startSessions: `if ('stage' in context) return refuse(...)` and `if (!built.ok) return refuse(built.stage, built.reason)`
notMutated.why: Forwarding only: sessionContextOf's statement refusal is killed through M12; buildInventoryBrief refuses only when SEC-3 cannot be quoted from the records root's adopted doctrine, which the fixture sources read from the real checkout, where it can.

notMutated.predicate: session-handover.ts startSessions: the catch around the directory and record writes
notMutated.why: An I/O failure arm (a write refused by the file system after every check passed); no input reaches it without fault injection.
Reachable only by a race: handOver calls deliverReview only after waitingReviewSession returned a session for the same run and kind.

notMutated.predicate: session-handover.ts handOver: the clauses `isReviewKind(rest.kind)` and `RUN_ID.test(path.basename(target))` in the delivery condition
notMutated.why: Equivalent without them: for a kind outside the two, or a path that is not a run, waitingReviewSession finds no waiting prompt record and returns null, so the call falls through to sessionPrompt, which refuses a missing kind at stage `role` (review-408 round 2, section D).
Not a predicate on input: a conversion of a stream chunk to bytes. The reader's bound is mutated (F5d).
